name: ssrf-pivot-lance
concept: Discovery and exploitation tool that finds SSRF sinks in allowlisted lab web apps via fuzzing URL/redirect/proxy parameters across GET/POST/JSON bodies, then uses each confirmed SSRF as a pivot to reach internal-only services (internal HTTP ports, emulated cloud-metadata endpoints, internal admin panels) and chains SSRF into file reads or blind RCE (metadata token -> internal API auth).
attack_vectors: parameter-based SSRF sink discovery (url,next,redirect,uri,path,src,proxy,feed,fetch) via payload mutation + reflection/delay-outbound detection
scheme/port allowlist bypass (127.0.0.1 vs 0177.0.0.1, IPv6 ::1, decimal/hex IPv4, lab DNS-rebinding aliases)
local file access via file:// , gopher:///dict:// to reach internal app internals and leak configs/tokens
cloud-metadata pivot (emulated 169.254.169.254) to mint creds that authenticate to internal admin API and trigger blind command execution
dependencies: stdlib only: http.server callback listener, socket, urllib, ssl, json, re
self-owned internal services: Flask test app with SSRF sink(s), internal admin API, emulated 169.254.169.254 metadata endpoint
scope_gate: Every target and every outbound pivot host is resolved through a CIDR/loopback allowlist resolver: SSRF candidates extracted only from hosts already on lab CIDR or loopback, metadata endpoint honored only when it resolves inside the emulated 169.254/16 lab subnet, red WARN banner on first run plus explicit --confirm-lab flag before any external socket opens.
